title: Write operator peering guide
description:
Write docs/operator/peering.md: how to configure transit-to-transit peering, what IHAVE/TAKETHIS means operationally, how gossipsub mesh forms, how to diagnose propagation failures, how to add/remove peers without restart (if supported), typical latency from ingestion to propagation. Artifact: docs/operator/peering.md.

Acceptance criteria: explains both push (IHAVE) and gossipsub propagation paths; includes transit peer-list and admin endpoint usage; covers common failure modes
